identity.name: Al-Monitor
identity.description: A Washington-based digital publication providing news and analysis on the Middle East, with country-specific editions and a policy-oriented audience.

ownership.ownershipNotes: Operated as Al-Monitor LLC. The exact ultimate ownership and investor structure was not independently verified in this review; the publication is editorially independent of any single regional government.

editorialOrientation.evidence: Washington-based regional specialist with bylined analysis and a range of Middle East voices; ownership opacity is a transparency concern.
editorialOrientation.source: Ownership and self-description via secondary references (official about page blocked or unavailable); secondary references; feed-level sample

politicalLeaning.evidence: No parsed MBFC rating; self-assessed as centrist and policy-analytic, with a Washington foreign-policy vantage point.
politicalLeaning.source: Analyst assessment from publisher self-description, secondary references and feed-level sample

economicPerspective.evidence: Economic coverage is secondary and framed through sanctions, energy and regional investment.
economicPerspective.source: Analyst assessment from business and economic coverage

internationalAlignment.evidence: US foreign-policy audience and Washington-based framing, with strong attention to US Middle East policy.
internationalAlignment.source: Ownership, editorial positioning and regional coverage sample

reliability.evidence: Professional regional specialists and named authors, but ownership opacity and analysis-heavy content reduce confidence.
reliability.source: Analyst assessment from ownership, editorial record and feed-level sample

externalRatings.notes: No MBFC rating identified for Al-Monitor.

intelligence.knownPerspective: Washington-based Middle East analysis, strongest on Iran, Turkey, Israel and US regional policy.

selectionRationale: Adds specialist Middle East policy analysis from a Washington vantage point, complementing regional national outlets.

feeds.feedTitle: AL-MONITOR: The Pulse of The Middle East

research.researchNotes: Exact parent/owner unresolved; recorded as Al-Monitor LLC. Official About page was not captured. Feed validated. Research is feed-level only; full article sampling and peer review remain outstanding.
